chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"When the slave slanders a free person with a false accusation of fornication, he is flogged eighty lashes." And he said: "This is among the rights of the people."

key_terms.حُقُوقِ النَّاسِ: the rights owed to people, not waived as purely divine claims

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave falsely accuses a free person of fornication in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling that if a slave commits qadhf against a free person, the prescribed punishment is eighty lashes. It also clarifies that this matter falls under the category of the rights of people, highlighting its juridical and social significance.
